headline: Instagram launches content protection tool against copycat videos
summary: Instagram began rolling out a 'content protection' feature that lets eligible creators automatically detect and review copies of their original videos posted elsewhere on the platform, alerting them to matches. The tool targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos, likely responding to creators' concerns about content being copied and manipulated using generative AI.
